newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed little changed at 8.2908 on Friday from Thursday's 8.2907 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai with pro-yuan sentiment prevailing in the market, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2913.
Dealers said expectations of a better trade surplus supported the yuan at the higher level, but its topside of 8.2900 was still capped.
The yuan opened at 8.2909 and consolidated mainly in the range of 8.2903 and 8.2910 for most of the session, hitting an intraday high of 8.2900 and a sudden low of 8.2947.
Trading was active with most done at 8.2907, dealers said.
One dealer said expectations of good trade data, due to be released within the coming few days, had attracted some buying to support the yuan at the higher level.
"Most people think the trade surplus will increase, so a greater supply of dollars would favour the yuan's upward momentum," he said.
A second dealer said selling pressure was still heavy at the the key resistance level of 8.2900.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to move below the 8.2900 level next Monday.
The yuan closed up at 7.2850 from 7.3468 against 100 Japanese yen and up at an intraday high of 1.0695 from 1.0703 against the Hong Kong dollar.
